title: Food Delivery: Pricing, Matching, and Notifications
description: Add dynamic pricing, delivery partner matching, and real-time notifications.

data.text: Add surge pricing based on demand, intelligent delivery partner assignment, and real-time push notifications for order status changes.

data.title: SurgePricing and PartnerMatcher
Demand-based surge
data.text: Surge pricing multiplies the base price by a demand ratio. Monitor active orders vs available partners in a geographic grid. Start with 1.0x, scale to 2.0x+ during peak hours.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Push notifications use device tokens per user
Real-time updates need WebSockets or SSE
data.takeaway: Food delivery is a marketplace with dynamic pricing and matching. Surge balances supply and demand. Matching is a greedy nearest-partner algorithm.
